svg.title: Surgeon — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as surgeon, wearing scrubs and a surgical cap. Visible work cue: A diagonal surgical scalpel has a slender handle and a clearly tapered curved cutting blade. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a surgical cap.
